description: Experimenter's post-replay judgement of every distinct alert key, against the revealed final report, the owner's historical facts and the repository. Verdicts: supported (true and evidenced), partially-supported (true as measured, but the measure overstates), supported-uncertainty (an uncertainty that was correct to raise), unsupported (no evidence), false (contradicted).

alerts.rationale: No session transcript or push log is published; the report itself says the primary session's token totals were not exposed (§15).
Report §16: 'The approved scope for this run was the content catalog'; the catalog pin at 6ee2281 is the first repository evidence of that choice.
Report §5: catalog 199/199 applicable mandatory obligations PASS; frozen v4.1.2 plan 0/541 executable and 0/119 record obligations verified.

True as measured: no frozen-plan requirement ID is cited in any changed file (checked by grep across src, web and tests). But the builder did write an F# domain kernel and workspace views for the content model, so T13 and T22 were partly served under the catalog's IDs; 'not started' overstates. The alert text now states its measure.
The first workflow run was created at 01:13:08, 22 minutes after the first application commit; the observer drew no failure conclusion.
32 of 32 applicable required catalog requirements PASS in requirement-verification.json for candidate 33d072d (report §4: 36 of 37 applicable, including optional ones).

Informational and factual: web/boundary.js is absent and web/main.js boots the Limen kernel. Report §3 confirms Limen 0.9.1 is used. Low value; not a defect.

No builder commit after 0e76050 (02:25:49Z); the run ended with about 305 minutes unused.
The 12-second failure at 1f2206b had no cause line in the collected tail; the next commit (ececa70) installed the SDK pin. Raising an uncertainty rather than a defect was correct.
Run 41752595151 failed with 'a content fault probe was not detected'; report §9 describes a probe that survived and the test fix; the next run passed.
Report §10: the first deploy at 39dc037 failed for lack of the pinned SDK; PR #2 fixed it.

Report §11: the gate fails in run-suites on every run; the plan's suite commands cannot run (MSB1008) and the plan's tests do not exist. The observer's classification (infrastructure, not an application defect, but blocking all frozen-plan verification) matches.
Report §11: release runs 41756889999 and 41758805409 REFUSED with three suites producing no result file.
Report §12: 'The work item was begun after the first application commits, not before them. This is a process deviation.'

HANDOFF.md was never updated from the bootstrap template and no Praxis checkpoint exists. In local mode, the 'unpushed commits' item (T+36..T+42) rests on the first CI run as an upper bound on push time, so it is plausible rather than proven.
